name: AURA
description: AURA stands for Automated Utility for Retrieval of Assets. It is a tool designed to use Mediux images for your media server content. It provides a simple and intuitive web interface to browse and select image sets for your library. While there are many tools available for this purpose, AURA stands out by offering a visual web interface to preview images before selection.

paths.name: Media Path
paths.description: Path to the media directory. Both the host and container paths must match the Plex/Emby/Jellyfin path exactly. Read the configuration guide for more information.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: This is port for the WEB UI/Frontend of the app

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for running the container (for file permissions)

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for running the container (for file permissions)
